justification: Assessment returned INVALID and targeted exactly the ground-truth defect: Lemma 1's inference that the expansion hypothesis forces delta(G) > alpha*n (the 'contradiction' from |N(S)| <= n-1 is not a contradiction since alpha < 1/2 makes alpha <= 1/2 - 1/n hold for large n). Its witness (K_7 plus an isolated vertex, n=8, alpha=1/4) is the same construction family as the ground-truth witness (K_5 plus isolated vertex, n=6, alpha=1/3) and checks out: for every 4-set S, N(S) is all 7 clique vertices >= n/2 + alpha*n = 6, while delta(G) = 0 < alpha*n = 2. Same claim refuted, valid alternative witness.
